Tests markdown chunker records heading hierarchy on chunk metadata

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', uri: 'document.md'), { 'chunking' => { 'chunker_type' => 'markdown', 'max_characters' => 500, 'overlap' => 50, 'prepend_heading_context' => true } })
(result.results[0].chunks || []).each do |chunk|
  puts chunk.content
  puts chunk.metadata
end
```
